data_acquisition.fetch_method: TNG API with urllib3 retry adapter

outlier_detection.method: Interquartile Range (IQR) on cm_x and cm_y

C_topo.description: Topological complexity — density profile gradient irregularity

C_info.description: Information complexity — Shannon entropy of mass components

C_quant.description: Quantum-inspired complexity — von Neumann entropy proxy

C_int.proxy: log-mass + SFR + dynamical deviation (v2) | mass threshold 1e14 (v1, deprecated)

bugs: C_int dead: mass threshold 1e14Msun too high for TNG100-1 halos
C_quant saturated: spin values ~0.03 produce identical eigenvalues

fixes: C_int: log-mass scaling centered at 1e10 Msun
C_quant: vmax/veldisp anisotropy instead of spin

test_1_mass_gap.description: Welch's t-test and Mann-Whitney U on mass distribution
test_1_mass_gap.interpretation: Outliers are systematically under-massive by an order of magnitude

test_2_box_edge_effect.interpretation: Most outliers sit at simulation box boundaries — periodic truncation artifacts

test_3_kinematic_coldness.interpretation: Higher bulk velocity + lower dispersion = backsplash/infall signature

test_4_size_mass_residuals.interpretation: Some outliers compact (tidally stripped), others puffy

test_5_ac_deficit.description: Mann-Whitney U test on A_c by outlier status
test_5_ac_deficit.interpretation: Spatial outliers are NOT low-complexity halos

inverted_test_mass_normalized.description: Find low-A_c halos first, then check spatial properties
inverted_test_mass_normalized.method: Quartic mass trend removal, then 25th percentile A_c cutoff
inverted_test_mass_normalized.key_finding: Simple halos are 11x more massive, centrally clustered, and NOT at box edges. Complex halos are dispersed and more likely edge outliers.

cosmological_interpretation.what_ac_actually_measures: Dynamical maturity at z=0, not total assembly history

massive_relaxed_halos.reason: Early formation, efficient merging, long relaxation time — smooth profiles, isotropic kinematics

low_mass_active_halos.reason: Recent infall, tidal harassment, radial orbits — disturbed profiles, anisotropic kinematics

cosmological_interpretation.implication_for_cloud9: A_c successfully separates populations, but measures instantaneous dynamical state rather than cumulative assembly complexity. Reframing or adding historical component (merger trees) recommended.

recommended: Fetch TNG sublink merger trees for actual n_mergers_major/minor
Add C_time component for historical assembly weight
Validate against IllustrisTNG published halo catalogs
optional: Apply certified randomness (ETH-Zurich style) to bootstrap confidence
